## Problem

What are you trying to do that's hard or impossible today?

## Proposal

What you'd like to see. Which door does it touch — chat / serve / train / eval
(or a new module like `agents/`)?

## Constraints to respect

- [ ] Stays local + FOSS (no proprietary cloud deps)
- [ ] Doesn't add heavy/GPU deps to the core `serve` install (use an extra +
      compose profile if it's heavy)

## Alternatives considered

Anything you've already ruled out.
